title: 2026 McDonald’s All American Girls Game | Full Highlights | SportsCenter Next
description:
Watch the highlights from the 2026 McDonald’s All American Girls Game as the East defeat the West, 91-71. USC signee and No. 1 ranked prospect Saniyah Hall won the MVP award after scoring a game-high 21 PTS.
